settings.title: Halloween is not the point. The season is.
settings.body:
We built this catalogue for the months when the light gets low and the house asks for attention. October gets the loudest costume — a 12-foot ghost, a skeleton banner, a tower of glowing pumpkins. November keeps the pillows and the coir. December inherits the lace, the tapers, the quiet.

Nothing here was designed to be thrown out on November 1st.

settings.title: Three ways in.
settings.lede: The yard on its own is enough. The living room is enough. Or the whole scene, priced under the sum of its parts.
